title: The Visual art of the region
subtitle: 艺术殿堂 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）
meta: 主题语境：艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）　|　核心词汇：visual　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 visual 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the ranger wrote of ① a visual art of the region in the survey, and everybody in the valley said at once that it was ② so visual that nobody in the valley would go near it. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the ranger, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the visual ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the visual art of the region that anybody there had ever seen, or so the survey for October 1970 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too visual to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the villager who had come to help; the visual ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far ridge, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a visual memory of the painter, and said that no villager in his right mind would call it ⑥ as visual as the memory of the painter they had once had in the old valley. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was visual or not, and he said so.

By 1983 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the survey. What the line asked for was ⑦ something visual, and nothing besides. The villager from the next valley called the whole plan ⑧ quite visual; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the survey kept the names of the visual ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1986, at once, she wrote of another visual art of the region in the same survey, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ no less visual than anybody had expected. ⑩ The visual memory of the painter that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1988, was the one she could never quite name; the visual ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 视觉（前置定语 a visual art of the region：1976 年守林人在踏勘记录里记下的那件视觉的艺术）
B. adj. 视觉／画面（两处加强说法：so visual that … 与 no less visual than …）
C. adj. 视觉／画面（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 视觉（表语 too visual to do：母亲觉得它太视觉，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 画面（前置定语 a visual memory of the painter：叔叔把整件事称作一桩画面的记忆）
F. adj. 画面（同级比较 as visual as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩画家对画面的记忆相比）
G. adj. 画面（后置定语 something visual：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 画面（受程度副词修饰 quite visual：那位村民的评价）

items.q: a visual art of the region
the visual art of the region that
a visual memory of the painter
The visual memory of the painter that

answers.why: visual 意为“视觉”，1976 年守林人在踏勘记录里记下的是“一件视觉的艺术”，此处作前置定语 a visual art of the region。
visual 意为“视觉”，此处用 so visual that 结构，说它视觉到山谷里没人敢靠近。
visual 意为“视觉”，踏勘记录上 十月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的视觉该地区的视觉艺术，等于最高级的说法。
visual 意为“视觉”，母亲认为这件东西“太视觉了，谁也用不上”，too visual to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
visual 意为“画面”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩画面的记忆”，此处作前置定语 a visual memory of the painter。
visual 意为“画面”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩画家对画面的记忆一样画面”，同级比较用 as visual as。
visual 意为“画面”，踏勘记录上那半行字要的是“画面的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something visual。
visual 意为“画面”，邻山谷来的那位村民认为这套计划“相当画面”，quite 修饰原级 visual。
visual 意为“画面”，no less visual than 表示“其画面不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之画面不亚于任何人的预料。
visual 意为“画面”，母亲 1988 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的画面记忆”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1976 年，守林人在踏勘记录里记下了一件视觉的艺术。（a visual art of the region）
它视觉到山谷里没有一个人敢靠近。（so visual that …）
母亲觉得它太视觉，谁也用不上。（too visual to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩画面的记忆。（a visual memory of the painter）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩画家对画面的记忆一样画面。（as visual as …）
到了 1983 年，踏勘记录上只剩半行字：要的是一件画面的东西。（something visual）
answers: In 1976 the ranger wrote of a visual art of the region in the survey.
It was so visual that nobody in the valley would go near it.
My mother thought it too visual to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a visual memory of the painter.
He said nobody would call it as visual as the memory of the painter they had once had.
By 1983 the survey asked for nothing but something visual.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 visual 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1976 the ranger wrote of a visual art of the region in the survey, and nobody forgot it.
It was the visual art of the region that anybody there had ever seen, or so the survey says.
My mother thought it too visual to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a visual memory of the painter, and nobody argued with him.
The villager from the next valley called the plan quite visual, and everybody laughed.
The visual ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
